prd.oneLiner: Connect demand forecasts, supply plans, inventory, purchase orders, receipts, delivery commitments, risk response, and supply-chain metrics.
prd.goal: Reduce stockout risk for critical items while improving on-time delivery and demand-forecast accuracy.
prd.whyNow: Demand changes, supplier commitments, inventory, and transport status live in separate systems, making stockout and delay risks difficult to anticipate.
prd.problem: Demand changes, supplier commitments, inventory, and transport status live in separate systems, making stockout and delay risks difficult to anticipate.
prd.solution: Connect demand forecasts, supply plans, inventory, purchase orders, receipts, delivery commitments, risk response, and supply-chain metrics.
prd.alternatives: Email, chat, spreadsheets, and manual ledgers
prd.differentiator: Manage intake, processing, and operations data as one connected source of truth.

targets.name: Procurement, logistics, and production practitioner managing demand, supply, inventory, and delivery commitments
targets.needs: Quickly register needed work and know its status.
targets.pain: Demand changes, supplier commitments, inventory, and transport status live in separate systems, making stockout and delay risks difficult to anticipate.

targets.name: SCM and supply-chain operations coordinator
targets.needs: Manage priority and history and review operations metrics.
targets.pain: Demand changes, supplier commitments, inventory, and transport status live in separate systems, making stockout and delay risks difficult to anticipate.

targets.name: System and policy administrator
targets.needs: Manage access, policy, and audit history.
targets.pain: Demand changes, supplier commitments, inventory, and transport status live in separate systems, making stockout and delay risks difficult to anticipate.

scenarios.text: An operational user registers required work and checks its status.
An operator processes queued work and handles exceptions.
System and policy administrator reviews policy and access.
System and policy administrator reviews audit records and operating metrics.

prd.northStar: Share of operations requests completed on time

kpis.name: On-time processing rate
kpis.target: Reduce stockout risk for critical items while improving on-time delivery and demand-forecast accuracy.
kpis.method: Monthly aggregation of state changes against target dates

kpis.name: Operations visibility
kpis.method: Share of records connected to reporting

inScope: Supplier, item, demand forecast, supply plan, and constraint registration
Demand, inventory, purchase order, receipt, delivery commitment, and supply-risk history lookup
Demand planning, supply allocation, purchasing, receipt confirmation, delay response, and exception approval handling
Inventory turns, on-time delivery, supply risk, stockout, and forecast-accuracy reporting
Supplier, item, demand forecast, supply plan, and constraint registration validation and duplicate prevention
nonGoals: Replacing adjacent systems such as accounting or payroll
assumptions: User and organization data are available through company SSO.
Operators manage policy and classification criteria.
risks: Weak initial classification can cause incorrect processing.
Stale source data can reduce operational trust.
openQuestions: What defines urgent processing and approval?
What are the post-completion verification and reopen rules?
constraints: State, owner, and priority changes require audit logs.
Permission, policy, and state changes require audit logs.
